info.title: DoubleMusic Module API
info.description: Contract implemented by optional HTTP modules in any language. IDs belong to the module and have no prefix. DoubleMusic adds the namespace, authenticates clients, and stores personal libraries. The module token is independent of user accounts.

moduleToken.description: Secret shared between DoubleMusic and the module. This is not a user session.
